render_depth_from_sdf: render depth from signed distance field samples along a ray using z values and SDF values
compute_surface_normals: compute surface normals in the camera frame from a depth render and SDF map
render_weighted_sum: compute a weighted sum of values along a specified dimension for general rendering
review_sdf_render_depth: review the sdf_render_depth function that finds zero crossings to estimate surface depth from SDF samples
refactor_render_normals: refactor the render_normals function to compute surface normals from SDF gradients in the camera frame
